$description: SisyphusFit design tokens (SPEC:R62). One source: tools/tokens.py checks it, writes SPEC.md's token tables from it and generates CSS and the app's Tokens.kt from it. Two layers: raw values (grey ramp, alpha black) and roles that screens use; screens never use a raw value. Greyscale until the palette is discussed (R53): when colour comes, only the roles' references change. Sizes are dp, text sizes and line heights sp (R56); density values are balanced / compact (R57).

grey.$description: Named by CIE L* (rounded down). Every value is used by the decided screens (R65, R88).

black.$description: Black at an alpha, for shadows, the scrim and a pressed light piece.

card.$description: comparison card, facts, light pebbles (steppers, the rest round's control), the tab bar

worn.$description: module cards, week sections, the resume card and rows: cut left, worn right (R65)

worn-light.$description: the soft light toward their worn right side

sunk.$description: the bottom zone behind the main bar; secondary pills

dark.$description: every dark fill of the interface: main bar, tab bar line and underline, selected states (R65)

dark-light.$description: the faint light inside the main bar's dip

primary.$description: text, icons, the current set's pebble outline

secondary.$description: secondary text, the evidence-note chip, tags

edge.$description: outlines (flat rows), the 1.5 dp underline of a number you tap to type, the sheet's grab handle, switches

carved-dark.$description: a carved line's cut: column heads, the chip's lines (3 dp, dark over light)

carved-light.$description: a carved line's lit edge; the 0.7 dp light under object icons

spindle.$description: History's carved date divider (owner 2026-10-28: the edge grey, not a grey of its own)

ground.$description: the 2 dp ground under a pill

step.$description: the 1 dp shadow under light pebbles and the worn cards you press: their edge on the page (R126)

pressed.$description: drawn over a light piece while it is pressed, in its own shape (R127)

pressed-dark.$description: a dark piece's fill while it is pressed, under its label (R127)

focus.$description: the focus ring, outside the piece's shape (R127)

stone.$description: the boulder and the figure (R75, R76)

ring-track.$description: the white ring's track before it fills: the near leg's grey (R77)

ring.$description: the ring and the time are the only white in the round (R74)

pad.$description: inside a card or row, at its sides

pad-y.$description: inside a worn card, above and below its content (R126)

gap.$description: between items in a list; compact keeps 8 as drawn and judged (the base compact scale had 4)

eyebrow.$description: under a section head: at least half its line (R126)

foot.$description: around the main bar in the bottom zone

note-head.$description: an evidence note's sheet: under its eyebrow, before the claim (owner, 2026-10-28 walk)

row.$description: minimum height of a row (R56: text may make it taller)

card.$description: minimum height of a module card

button.$description: minimum height of the main bar and buttons

stepper.$description: the − / + pebbles beside a set value

float.$description: height of the floating running control as a pill (R69)

float-round.$description: the floating running control as a round (R69: recordings, the interval timer)

rest-control.$description: the rest round's touch target (R76); the boulder is 80 at font size 1.0 and grows with the time (R80)

tab-bar.$description: the tab bar at font size 1.0; it grows with its labels (R66)

worn.$description: cut on the left, worn on the right (R65)

full.$description: round ends: the grab handle, close and note chips

pebble-a.$description: light pebbles: the reps steppers, the rest round's control, the current set's outline

pebble-b.$description: light pebbles: the weight and partials steppers

selected.$description: a selected box, segment or chip

line.$description: the tab bar's line, the tap-to-type underline, the current set's pebble outline

carved.$description: a carved line, dark over light (R65)

underline.$description: the current tab's underline on the valley floor (R66)

ring.$description: the rest round's white ring and its track

focus-gap.$description: between a piece's shape and its focus ring (R127)

ground.$description: a pill standing on the ground

valley.$description: the tab valley sliding to the new tab (R66)

step.$description: one push step of the figure (R74)

stone-turn.$description: about one turn of the stone (R74)

reduced.$value: nothing turns or slides; the figure holds still; the ring and the time move once a second; the valley jumps (R74, R66)

type.$description: R60: size and line height balanced / compact in sp; carve set by the token (0 up to 16, 100 above); Sisifo (R59).

comparison.$description: in the comparison card the roles keep their weight and carve at these sizes, the same at both densities (R60, R81)

chip.$description: the evidence-note chip, on every screen it appears (R60, R81)

note-claim.$description: an evidence note's claim: the row title's size on looser lines (owner, 2026-10-28 walk: 28 at balanced; compact keeps 24, already that proportion at 17 sp)

targets.$description: R126 and R60: what tools/tokens.py check computes. Each text colour on each surface it sits on; each fill you press on its ground, with its edge when it has one; the picked against the unpicked outline; the heads with the space under them.

marks.what: the main bar, the tab line, the ticked box

controls.what: light pebbles: steppers, the rest round's control
worn cards you press: module cards, the resume card, rows

picked.what: segments and chips: 2 dp against 1 dp
